items.name: Group of Interest Warning
items.description: Attention all relevant groups of interest. You are advised to cease violation of protocol or usage of force will be exercised.

items.name: Group of Interest KOS Order
items.description: Attention, a group of interest has been declared hostile, and outlawed by the foundation. Personnel may fire at will.

items.name: SCP Breach Announcement
items.description: Attention all Installation-45 personnel, an anomaly has been reported outside the heavy containment zone. Go to the shelters immediately.

items.name: Medical Assistance Alert
items.description: Attention any available medical personnel, please report to ######## for medical assistance.

items.name: Incursion Announcement
items.description: Attention all Installation-45 personnel, a hostile break-in has been reported in deadzone 1. Enact raid protocol immediately.

items.name: Protocol Scarlet Armada
items.description: Attention all Installation-45 security, special protocol Scarlet Armada is now active. Refer to the defense protocol document for more information.

items.name: Ethics Committee Alert
items.description: Attention, Ethics Committee presence requested at #######, please respond in a timely manner.

items.name: Combative Status Report
items.description: Attention Installation-45 Combatants, please report your status immediately. Failure to respond may result in a false alarm.
